messages:
caroline: FYI seeing a sustained p95 tail in apac1 dedicated-slice-B since ~03:12 UTC, looks like a new tenant onboarding churn.
liam: Which signal? GPU latency or network egress?
caroline: p95 latency for short-generation routes spiked from ~350ms to ~1.1s, GPU util jumped and nvme iowait ticked up. egress queues show long tails.
prasanna: can paste the short dump: ```
p95_gen_ms: 350 -> 1100
gpu_util_pct: 62 -> 94
nvme_iowait_ms: 2 -> 18
egress_queue_len: 8 -> 320
``` 
liam: ugh. Any dedicated pool procs moved in recently?
caroline: onboarding job from tenant-sprocket started ramping at 03:05 UTC, bursty prefill + kvcache regen. correlates.
prasanna: I can try a soft-carve (fractional carveout) to isolate the prefill traffic to a small warmpool. prefer to avoid full dedicated due to cost.
alice-finance: heads-up, fractional carveouts still bill as reserved capacity while in carve state — estimate ~ $420/day at 20% of that slice in apac1.
prasanna: noted. propose: carveout 20% of slice-B to apac1-warmpool, add egress policer to tenant-sprocket and route low-latency traffic to fallback pool in apac2 for 2 hours while they finish onboarding.
liam: +1 for policer + routing. can we do weighted routing instead of hard failover? 20% reroute initially then scale if p95 doesn't fall.
caroline: I'll annotate pool: `pool:apac1-slice-B` with new eviction weight and add a routing rule TTL 2h.
prasanna: commands I plan to run: ```
allocatorctl carve --pool apac1-slice-B --target apac1-warmpool --fraction 0.2 --reason "tenant-sprocket onboarding churn" 
configctl route-weight --from apac1-slice-B --to apac2-fallback --weight 0.2 --ttl 7200
policerctl set --tenant tenant-sprocket --egress-rate 25mbps --burst 10mb
``` 
caroline: ops-bot showed prefill jobs at 03:07:12 with 48 concurrent processes, might need to coordinate with onboarding team to stagger. ops-bot: `prefill-orchestrator job tenant-sprocket started (48 workers)`.
ops-bot: Deployment notice: `onboarder/tenant-sprocket v2` created jobs at 03:05:08.
liam: After we apply the routing+policer, what's our success metric? p95 < 450ms and egress_queue_len < 50 ideally.
prasanna: agree. I'll apply routing dry-run first and then commit after 30s window. will post commands & diffs.
alice-finance: if we need to escalate to a temporary dedicated carve (full slice) ping me — we can approve for short windows but need a business case and cost ack.
caroline: ok running dry-run now, will report back in ~1m.
prasanna: dry-run output: ```
DRYRUN: carve plan OK, estimated migrated workload 18% of pool B
DRYRUN: route-weight change queued (0.2 -> apac2-fallback)
DRYRUN: policer config validated
``` 
caroline: committing now.
prasanna: committed. route-weight change propagated to edge proxies, policer applied to tenant-sprocket.
liam: seeing p95 drop in apac1 to ~480ms after 45s, egress_queue_len -> 60.
caroline: continuing to trend down. nvme iowait back to ~4ms.
alice-finance: noted costs: projected extra ~$180 for the next 8 hours at current carve fraction.
prasanna: will keep carve for 2h and then assess. if tenant finishes, we'll unwind and leave routing weight 0.
caroline: thanks all. will keep monitoring, create follow-up ticket to propose longer-term mitigation (prefill rate-limit, onboarding windowing, or dedicated warmpool for heavy prefill tenants). :thumbsup:
